stem: Nimbus Labs has one component triggered by S3 events for short transformations and another service that runs containers all day.

choices.text: Run both components on AWS Lambda
Run both components on AWS Fargate
Run both components on fixed EC2 instances
Use Lambda for event transforms and Fargate for all-day containers.

rationale: Lambda is optimized for short event-driven execution, while Fargate fits long-running container workloads without host management. Running both on Lambda can conflict with long-duration container service behavior. Running both on Fargate can work but often overpays for short event bursts relative to Lambda billing model. Running both on fixed EC2 can increase operational overhead and idle-capacity cost.
